dct_title_s: Quae intus continentur : Syria, ad Ptolomaici operis rationem. Praeterea Strabone, Plinio, & Antonio auctoribus locupletata. : Palestina, iisdem auctoribus. Praeterea historia sacra, & Iosepho, & diuo Hieronymo locupletata. : Arabia Petraea, siue, Itinera filiorum Israel per desertum, iisdem auctoribus. Aegyptus, iisdem auctoribus. Praeterea Ioanne Leone arabe grammatico, secundum recentiorum locorum situ[m] illustrata. : Schondia, tradita ab auctoribus, qui in eius operis prologo memorantur. Holmiae, ciuitatis regi[ae] Suetiae, deplorabilis excidij per Christiernum Datiae cimbricae regem, historia. Regionum superiorum, singulae tabulae geographicae
dct_description_sm: Contains 8 double-page woodcut maps with descriptive text on the recto of the first leaf of each map, bound at the end. There are 7 maps of the Middle East and Holy Land (one including Cyprus) and one of northern Europe and Scandinavia ("Schondia") with part of Britain, Ireland and "Gronlandia incognita Terra" depicted.
Dedication signed by Jacob Ziegler (leaf II).
Errata statement on leaves [17-18] at end
Includes list of latitude and longitude coordinates of 500 places of the exodus route.
Leaf V wrongly numbered IIII, numbers CIII-CVIII repeated in foliation; maps are bound before this second sequence CIII onwards.
Signatures: a-s⁶ t-v⁴ A-B⁶ C⁴ D² (sig. A-C folding map)
The term "Schondia" in the title is used for Greenland and other northern regions.
